title: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract: Granting an Extension and Booking Its Fee
content:
**Servicing Policy Manual and desk system reference — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

## Scope

This policy grants an extension of a retail installment contract whose customer has completed the signed extension agreement for this contract, deferring the installment due on the contract's next due date, and figures the extension fee booked with it.

The status, installment count, days-past-due, lifetime, blackout, relationship, signed-agreement and interval conditions of the company's extension rule for this product apply as that rule states them, and the schedule moves exactly as that rule states.

## What the grant waits on

The extension is not granted until the installment it defers, when a returned payment re-opened it and its grace period has ended, shows its late charge in the contract's ledger.

The extension is granted only after a payment through the agent-assisted phone ACH channel has posted on the contract since its most recent installment due date.

The extension fee is fixed only after the customer has made the good-faith payment toward the extension, wherever the good-faith amount for the extension is above 0.00.

## Booking the extension

The extension is booked with the agent-side tool `grant_retail_extension_6a93006b`. It is a hidden tool: the agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**What one call does.** One call records one extension: the named installment and as many following ones as are deferred move to the end of the term, the contract's next due date and maturity date each move one calendar month later per deferred installment (a day that does not exist in the target month falls back to that month's last day), the count of installments deferred over the life of the contract rises by the number deferred, the latest extension date becomes today, and the extension fee is added to the fees due on the contract. The customer can see the new next due date and maturity date on the account at once.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `retail_contract_id` | the reference number of the retail installment contract being extended, as returned by the retail contract lookup (`find_retail_contracts`) |
| `customer_id` | the reference number of the customer who holds the contract, as returned by the customer profile lookup |
| `retail_request_id` | the reference number of the customer's completed signed extension agreement for this contract, as returned by the signature request lookup (`find_retail_requests`) |
| `installment_due_date` | the due date of the earliest installment being deferred, written YYYY-MM-DD as a calendar date with no time zone; never empty |
| `installments_deferred` | the number of installments being deferred, a non-negative integer |
| `good_faith_amount` | the good-faith payment received from the customer for this extension, in USD with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent; 0.00 when none was received |
| `extension_fee` | the extension fee booked to fees due, in USD with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent; 0.00 when no fee is charged |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the extension reference (an opaque text identifier of the booked extension), the contract reference, the number of installments deferred, the new next due date and the new maturity date (both YYYY-MM-DD) and the extension fee booked in USD with 2 decimal places. A sentence that starts with "Extension granted" means the extension is in effect on the contract.
